variants.specifics: Garrick at Brackenford's north gate, shut by Reeve Halvard against Red Corwin's bandits.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: Halt! The north gate is shut by Reeve Halvard's order. Corwin's bandits rob the road beyond. Complaints go to the Reeve himself.

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: Still shut. Off with you, now.

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: Gate's open! Corwin won't be robbing anyone now. Go on through.

variants.specifics: Hobb guards the lift to the lower tunnels of a mining town; Foreman Dagna closed it over a Troll in the deep seam.

first.speaker: Hobb
first.text: Nobody goes below! A Troll's loose in the deep seam. Foreman Dagna's orders, and she's down at the lamp house.

again.speaker: Hobb
again.text: Below's shut. Lamp house is behind you.

later.speaker: Hobb
later.text: So the Troll's finished? Then the lift's yours. Mind your head down there.

variants.specifics: Tam watches the cut walkway of a stilt hamlet in the swamp; Mother Brea cut it because the witch Slake sends the drowned dead up the ladders.

first.speaker: Tam
first.text: Hold there! The walkway's cut. The witch Slake sends the drowned dead up our ladders. Mother Brea cut it -- her hut's the tall one.

again.speaker: Tam
again.text: Mind the planks. Some are rotten.

later.speaker: Tam
later.text: Slake's done for? Then I'll lay the planks back myself! Off you go, and watch for leeches.

variants.specifics: Osric, a sentry of a castle garrison, keeps the river gate barred by Captain Rowan while the deserter Brannoch holds the toll bridge.

first.speaker: Osric
first.text: By order of Captain Rowan, the river gate is barred, citizen. That deserter Brannoch holds the toll bridge beyond it. The Captain is at the barracks.

again.speaker: Osric
again.text: Do not make me repeat myself, citizen.

later.speaker: Osric
later.text: The traitor Brannoch is slain! The river gate stands open by the Captain's leave. Pass, and be welcome.

variants.specifics: Dobbs keeps the boats chained at a fishing village on a lake; Mayor Liss forbids crossings while Kell's raiders sink skiffs.

first.speaker: Dobbs
first.text: Boats stay chained! Kell's raiders sank two skiffs last week. Mayor Liss decides who crosses -- she's up in the net loft.

again.speaker: Dobbs
again.text: Chained, I tell you. Tighter than my wife's purse.

later.speaker: Dobbs
later.text: Kell's feeding the eels now! Take any boat you like... except mine.

variants.specifics: Quill, porter of a wizards' college, bars the lower stacks that Archivist Pell sealed after a student woke a Lich.

first.speaker: Quill
first.text: No admittance! Archivist Pell has sealed the lower stacks. Some fool of a student woke a Lich among the scrolls. Appeals go to the Archivist, in writing.

later.speaker: Quill
later.text: Ahem. The lower stacks are open again, now the Lich is gone. Kindly keep your voice down.

variants.specifics: Bors guards the pass gate of a frozen mountain fort; Warden Hask keeps it shut while Black Hilde's raiders camp in the pass.

first.speaker: Bors
first.text: Brrr... Gate's frozen shut anyway. Black Hilde's raiders are camped up in the pass. Warden Hask won't open it till she's dead.

later.speaker: Bors
later.text: Well! The Warden's opened the gate, so Hilde must be dead. Up you go -- the pass is yours.

variants.specifics: Orrin keeps the slag bridge of a forge town closed by Guildmaster Vask while an Ember Demon prowls past it.

first.speaker: Orrin
first.text: Back! The slag bridge is closed. There's an Ember Demon loose on the far side. Take it up with Guildmaster Vask -- he never leaves the great anvil.

again.speaker: Orrin
again.text: Hot out here, isn't it? Move along.

later.speaker: Orrin
later.text: The Guildmaster says the bridge is open again. Cross quick -- the stones still smoke.

variants.specifics: Nim, a hired hand at a crossroads inn, minds the gate Marta put across the west road against a highwayman called the Gentleman.

first.speaker: Nim
first.text: Psst... the west road's closed. A highwayman called the Gentleman has been robbing coaches. Marta at the inn put this gate up -- go and moan at her.

later.speaker: Nim
later.text: Marta says leave the gate open, now that fancy Gentleman's in the ground. So I'm leaving it open!

variants.specifics: Wilf guards the palisade of a farming town, shut by the Mayor while the Ogre chief Mugrot raids the fields.

first.speaker: Wilf
first.text: Whoa! The palisade's shut. The Ogre chief Mugrot carried off three cows and a farmhand last night. Go and beg the Mayor, if you like.

again.speaker: Wilf
again.text: Ask the Mayor! I just stand here.

later.speaker: Wilf
later.text: Mugrot's dead! The Mayor's opened the palisade, and my cows are safe. Well... the ones that are left.
